   246→	key = append(key, bytesutil.Bytes32(uint64(proposerIndex))...)

   274→			cols[entry.ColIdx] = entry
   275→			slotStats[entry.Slot] = cols

   279→					colIndices      = make([]uint64, 0, fieldparams.NumberOfColumns)
   280→					peers           = make([]string, 0, fieldparams.NumberOfColumns)
   281→					gossipScores    = make([]float64, 0, fieldparams.NumberOfColumns)
   282→					validationTimes = make([]string, 0, fieldparams.NumberOfColumns)
   283→					sinceStartTimes = make([]string, 0, fieldparams.NumberOfColumns)
   284→				)

   288→					if entry.PeerSuffix == "" {

   290→					}

   294→					validationTimes = append(validationTimes, fmt.Sprintf("%.2fms", float64(entry.validationTime.Milliseconds())))
   295→					sinceStartTimes = append(sinceStartTimes, fmt.Sprintf("%.2fms", float64(entry.sinceStartTime.Milliseconds())))
   296→					totalReceived++

   304→					"gossipScores":    gossipScores,
   305→					"validationTimes": validationTimes,
   306→					"sinceStartTimes": sinceStartTimes,
   307→				}).Debug("Accepted data column sidecars summary")
